description: $0.05 USDC on Solana — the payment buys one full manifest-claim audit report for one submitted MCP manifest: the verdict line and score under the published criteria, per-tool, per-check results with evidence, the findings list (spec-default traps, both-claimed traps, schema inconsistencies), and a concrete fix list. Submitted manifest content is processed in memory only and never stored; the paid retry re-sends the manifest (or its URL). It does not execute the server, observe its runtime behaviour, or certify that the server is safe or honest in operation.

manifest.description: The MCP server's tools/list manifest document, in any accepted shape: { tools: [...] }, { result: { tools: [...] } }, or a bare array of tools. Mutually exclusive with url. Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored.

url.description: The URL of a tools/list JSON document to fetch (read-only GET, 512 KB / 10 s caps) and grade as the manifest. Mutually exclusive with manifest.

name: manifest_audit
